info.title: The Ramparts of Ice
info.synopsis: Socialmente incapace di relazionarsi con gli altri, Koyuki Hikawa crea un muro fra lei e le persone che la circondano. Trascorre il suo tempo al liceo in solitudine fino a quando non incontra Minato Amemiya, un ragazzo che cerca di accorciare la distanza tra loro per qualche motivo. Koyuki e Minato, la popolare Miki e il gentile Yōta, questa è la storia di quattro giovani un po' complicati che sono confusi dalle proprie vite!

episodes.title: Lines and Walls
episodes.synopsis: After her classmates run off in fear, Koyuki makes faces in a mirror to figure out why everyone finds her scary. Suddenly, a boy sneaks up behind her.

episodes.title: Locksmith
episodes.synopsis: To Koyuki's relief, Yota comes to her rescue. After their initial study session, they grow more comfortable with each other — which unsettles Minato.

episodes.title: 3+(<-)1
episodes.synopsis: Bothered that Koyuki still has her guard up around him, Minato tries to make small talk. As Miki grows suspicious of his intentions, she confronts him.

episodes.title: Impenetrable
episodes.synopsis: At Miki's prodding, Minato clarifies his interest in her best friend. An unexpected visitor triggers Koyuki's bad memories, leading to a harsh outburst.

episodes.title: Change
episodes.synopsis: Koyuki mulls over the tense exchange in the infirmary. After Yota clears the air, she tries to have an honest conversation with Minato for the first time.

episodes.title: New Semester
episodes.synopsis: As winter break ends, the usually calm Minato begins to realize his feelings are changing. Miki notices how close Yota and Koyuki have become.

episodes.title: Loneliness and Solitude
episodes.synopsis: After reflecting on her own loneliness and worrying that Yota is bottling everything up, Koyuki reaches out and asks about his true feelings.

episodes.title: On Equal Footing
episodes.synopsis: Determined not to mess up high school, Miki has faked her persona since day one. But not being herself around her classmates starts to wear her down.

episodes.title: Self-awareness
episodes.synopsis: Minato realizes how Koyuki is always on his mind. Later, while hanging out at the new mall, the misunderstanding between the four friends deepens.

episodes.title: Spring
episodes.synopsis: A spring break trip to the amusement park brings the four friends closer. Back at school, Koyuki's surprised by a familiar face — and Minato takes notice.

episodes.title: Inversion
episodes.synopsis: Koyuki broods over her complicated past with Akine's sister, Manatsu, and what the first year might know. Meanwhile, Momoka sets her sights on Minato.

episodes.title: Thunder
episodes.synopsis: As Koyuki slowly notices her new, surprising feelings towards Minato, first-year Momoka suddenly tries to cozy up to her — for reasons she can't grasp.

episodes.title: Perception
episodes.synopsis: With Akine's words ringing in her head, Koyuki's feelings become complicated. Later, an accident causes something to shift between Miki and Yota.

episodes.title: Bombshell
episodes.synopsis: Unsure of how to move forward, Miki avoids Yota and confides in her colleagues. A bold Momoka confronts Koyuki about Minato and lights a fuse.

info.synopsis: Seconda stagione di Devil May Cry (2025)

info.title: Grow Up Show: Sunflower Circus
info.synopsis: Nel Giappone della fine degli anni '50, un’epoca di grande fermento economico, gli spettacoli itineranti vivono il loro massimo splendore. In tutto il paese, le compagnie circensi si danno battaglia per un unico, prestigioso obiettivo: ottenere un posto alla "Circus Collection", il festival nazionale più ambito del settore. Il Sunflower Circus è una piccola troupe carica di talento, ma sull'orlo del fallimento a causa di una pesante crisi finanziaria. Il destino del gruppo cambia radicalmente con l'arrivo di Mizuka Tsurumaki, una giovane artista dal talento fuori dal comune. Nonostante il suo carattere difficile e spesso scontroso generi inizialmente attriti tra i membri, la sua energia travolgente infonde nuova speranza alla troupe. Superando debiti e contrasti interni, i protagonisti iniziano così la loro scalata verso il sogno della Circus Collection.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Sunflower Circus!
episodes.synopsis: In 1950s Japan, penniless Mizuka meets two circus girls, sparking a dream-filled new beginning.

episodes.title: That Was So Dazzling
episodes.synopsis: The "Sunflower Circus" is headed to Toyokawa, a popular and officially sanctioned performance venue.

episodes.title: I Don`t Want to Show My Scars
episodes.synopsis: Determined to surpass "Shiny Lavender", the "Sunflower Circus" prepares for its upcoming show.

episodes.title: I Just Can`t Bring Myself to Be Honest
episodes.synopsis: The "Sunflower Circus" had a successful show in Toyokawa, but their earnings were seized by debt collectors.

episodes.title: There Is Nowhere I Belong
episodes.synopsis: Akane storms off as Mizuka searches the mountains for Rafflesia Circus’s missing François.

episodes.title: A Sinister Legend Summons a Storm
episodes.synopsis: Nanami Sumeragi’s team makes headlines with newspapers asking if they could surpass the "Lotus Circus."

episodes.title: I Don`t Get the Circus
episodes.synopsis: Mizuka, determined to challenge Mitscher, returns to the group members who all look very serious.

episodes.title: This Is What I Always Wanted
episodes.synopsis: With the Sumeragi Group’s elite troupe, the "Blue Rose Circus," nearby, the "Sunflower Circus" faces a predictably poor turnout for its next performance. Mizuka, having resolves to take the stage as a performer, nervously peeks out at the audience. After confiding her anxiety to Ouka in the wings, she trusts Ouka's advice—"look at the audience before you fly"—and Mizuka steps onto the trapeze.

episodes.title: Is All That Kindness Just a Lie?
episodes.synopsis: Maria collapses from exhaustion, and Rin fiercely scolds the troupe for causing chaos at the hospital.

episodes.title: Beyond the Stage of Dreams
episodes.synopsis: The "Sunflower Circus" has been granted permission to participate in the "Circus Collection Japan Tournament."

episodes.title: For Whose Sake Is This Unfulfilled Dream?
episodes.synopsis: Mizuka and Ouka are unable to hide their growing anxiety, pushing themselves with excessive training.

episodes.title: Where the Heart Resides - Weaving Dreams
episodes.synopsis: With surgery in the United States fast approaching, Maria was placed under a strict no-visitor policy.

episodes.title: Even Higher
episodes.synopsis: The opening day of the final performances has arrived.

info.synopsis: Secondo film della trilogia di Hathaway che celebra il 40° anniversario del franchise di Gundam, e il secondo progetto nel "UC NexT 0100 Project" che affronterà il futuro della timeline dell'UC.

episodes.title: Undercurrents Beyond the Pass
episodes.synopsis: Dao Ma recalls times long past, when the Sui Dynasty sought to conquer the Chen Dynasty and he—then still a nameless warrior—played a decisive role in the effort.

episodes.title: Night Attack on the Desert Oasis
episodes.synopsis: Emperor Wendi of the Sui Dynasty is dying. His sons, Guang Yang and Yong Yang, are vying for the succession. Which side will the Left Elite Guard support? What decision will Dao Ma ultimately make?

episodes.title: Mo Jia Village
episodes.synopsis: He Yixuan starts killing villagers while Dao Ma and Shu fight adversaries. The mercenary invaders are stopped by an unexpected order to retire, and Ayuya persuades a Wululu clan leader to free her. Diting and One-eye return with the hostages they have taken.

episodes.title: The Hunter and the Prey
episodes.synopsis: Dao Ma and his group are forced to confront the violent realities of the "Karma" sect and escalating political corruption as they push closer to the imperial center. Pursued by relentless government assassins, they must navigate shifting alliances to survive.
